Worry

You’re already welcome here. Rest first; then let one verse land.

When your mind rehearses tomorrow before today is finished, you are not failing—you are human. Scripture doesn’t shame the spiral; it hands you a shorter rope: one day, one prayer, KJV on this page.

No rush. Read slowly. Let one verse land.

Prayer Search “worry” in Scripture

When you want company beside you: Bible tool, Daily verse, Calm, Battle plans (7–40 days, KJV)—all optional doors.

Often walks with: Anxiety · Calm · Hope.

Walk the loop

This page gives you verses in reach. The Grace Ribbon is the slow room—breath, silence, one path where what you carry and what God says are not two separate tracks.

Open Grace Ribbon Journal Loop journal

Key Verses

Matthew 6:34

Take therefore no thought for the morrow: for the morrow shall take thought for the things of itself. Sufficient unto the day is the evil thereof.

Philippians 4:6

Be careful for nothing; but in every thing by prayer and supplication with thanksgiving let your requests be made known unto God.

Psalm 55:22

Cast thy burden upon the Lord, and he shall sustain thee: he shall never suffer the righteous to be moved.

A Gentle Word

Matthew 6:34 isn’t cold—it’s kind. God gives you today’s grace for today’s weight. You don’t have to carry Tuesday on Monday.

Hope — same care, more languages
